name: crlf_init_script
title: CRLF line endings break localstack_s3_client/init.sh, so the buckets are never created

found_by.how: Team guide setup fix (clone with core.autocrlf=false), applied before the reference run. Reproduced afterwards: a copy of localstack_s3_client with init.sh converted to CRLF, run in the project's image, not attached to the project network. An LF copy run the same way printed no \r errors.

command: docker run --rm -v <copy of localstack_s3_client with CRLF init.sh>:/app mlops-zoomcamp-project-localstack_s3_client
error_tail: Error parsing parameter '--assume-role-policy-document': Unable to load paramfile file://trust-policy.json: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'trust-policy.json\r'
Could not connect to the endpoint URL: "http://localstack:4566/"

cause.summary: Git on Windows (core.autocrlf=true) checks out init.sh with CRLF; bash keeps the \r
details: The container runs /bin/bash /app/init.sh, mounted from the host checkout.
Every line ends in \r: blank lines become the command $'\r', the endpoint URL becomes 'http://localstack:4566\r' (Invalid endpoint), file names become 'trust-policy.json\r'.
The buckets and the IAM role are not created; the container still exits, and dag_01 later fails writing to S3.

fix.summary: Check out with LF: git clone -c core.autocrlf=false (or a .gitattributes rule *.sh text eol=lf)
fix.action: Keep shell scripts LF in the working tree; a repo-level .gitattributes makes it independent of each teammate's git settings.

static_check.rule: a .sh file (or a file run by bash in a container) contains CRLF line endings

reproduce.how: Convert init.sh to CRLF in a copy of localstack_s3_client and run the image on it.
reproduce.note: Off the project network, so the last line is a connection error; on the network the \r errors are the same.
